faq.description: Answers to common questions about the 2.0 Ingenium petrol in the Land Rover Discovery Sport. If yours is not covered, our team can help.

faqs.q: Does my petrol Discovery Sport have the 204PT engine?
faqs.a: Not necessarily. Earlier petrol models used a different 2.0 turbo engine, so we check your VIN, model year and engine code before recommending any compatible replacement for your Discovery Sport.

faqs.q: How do used, reconditioned and rebuilt 204PT engines compare?
faqs.a: A used engine comes from a donor vehicle, a reconditioned engine is stripped and given new wear parts, and a rebuild restores your existing engine. We recommend an option after assessing the fault and vehicle.

faqs.q: Can I buy a Discovery Sport 2.0 petrol engine supply only?
faqs.a: Yes. Trade buyers, independent garages and private customers with their own mechanic can buy supply only. Alternatively, choose supply and fit and our technicians will install the engine at our Grays, Essex workshop.

faqs.q: What affects the cost of a Discovery Sport 204PT engine replacement?
faqs.a: The cost depends on the engine option, the condition of your current engine, any parts needed such as a turbo or cooling components, and whether fitting is included. Send your registration or VIN for a quote.

faqs.q: Is there a warranty on a replacement 204PT engine?
faqs.a: Warranty cover depends on the engine option and whether we carry out the installation. We confirm the exact terms in writing with your quote, so you know what is covered before work begins.

faqs.q: Do you deliver Ingenium petrol engines across the UK?
faqs.a: Yes. We deliver engines throughout the United Kingdom from our Grays workshop. Delivery arrangements and costs are confirmed in your quote, and supply and fit customers can bring their vehicle to us.

faqs.q: How long does a 204PT engine replacement usually take?
faqs.a: The timescale depends on engine availability, whether a rebuild is needed and any additional work found during inspection. We give you an estimated timeframe with your quote and keep you informed throughout.

workshopIntro.title: Repair, Rebuild or Replace Your 204PT?
workshopIntro.description: The fault, mileage and value of your Discovery Sport guide the decision. Coil, wastegate, coolant leak and fuel system faults can usually be repaired individually. If chain failure has damaged the valves or overheating has caused internal damage, a rebuild or Land Rover Discovery Sport 204PT engine replacement is often more practical.
paragraphs: A turbo petrol engine depends on clean oil and effective cooling. Where relevant, we inspect the thermostat housing, water pump, coolant pipes, turbo, breather system and fuel system, check the ignition components, and renew the oil, filters and coolant.

Send your registration or VIN with a short description of the symptoms. We will confirm compatibility, explain the options and quote for supply only, supply and fit at our Grays workshop, or delivery across the UK.

engineProblems.title: Common Discovery Sport 204PT Faults
engineProblems.description: The Ingenium petrol usually gives early warning signs, so prompt checks can prevent costly engine damage.

cards.title: Rear-Mounted Chain Stretch
cards.description: A rattle on start-up, camshaft correlation codes or rough running may indicate a stretched timing chain or worn tensioner at the rear of the engine. We measure chain stretch and check timing.

cards.title: Turbo Wastegate Rattle
cards.description: A metallic rattle on deceleration, boost fault codes or reduced power may point to wear in the turbocharger wastegate linkage or actuator. We test boost control and inspect the turbo.

cards.title: Coolant Leaks from Housings
cards.description: A falling coolant level, a sweet smell or rising temperature may come from a leaking thermostat housing, coolant pipe or water pump seal. We pressure-test the cooling system for leaks.
cards.action: Fuel rail and injector leak-off test

cards.title: Ignition Coil and Plug Misfires
cards.description: Juddering under acceleration, a flashing engine light or rough idle are often caused by worn spark plugs or failing ignition coils. We test the ignition system cylinder by cylinder.

cards.title: Oil Consumption and Smoke
cards.description: Frequent oil top-ups, blue smoke or oil in the intake may relate to turbo seal wear, breather faults or internal engine wear. We check oil use, breather operation and compression.

cards.title: Direct-Injection Fuel Faults
cards.description: Hesitation, hard starting or fuel pressure fault codes may come from a weak high-pressure fuel pump or faulty injectors. We test fuel pressure and injector performance.

engineOverview.title: Land Rover Discovery Sport 204PT Engine: Your Complete Ingenium Petrol Guide
paragraphs: The Land Rover Discovery Sport 204PT engine is the 2.0-litre four-cylinder Ingenium turbo petrol fitted to later petrol versions of the Discovery Sport. Smooth and responsive, it can develop timing chain wear, turbo wastegate noise, coolant leaks and misfires, leading owners to look for an Ingenium engine rebuild or replacement.

Earlier petrol Discovery Sport models used a different 2.0 turbo engine, and Ingenium petrol outputs also vary. We identify the correct Discovery Sport 2.0 engine by checking your VIN, the 204PT engine code and your registration before supply.

Whether you need a targeted repair, an engine rebuild or a complete Land Rover Discovery Sport 204PT engine replacement, our team inspects the vehicle and explains each option. Call us or send your registration for a written quote.
